import outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations
import outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime
import LongTails.Proofs.RingmasterExecution
import LongTails.Proofs.RennalaConvergence

open MeasureTheory
namespace outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence
open OracleTemplate OracleTemplate.RingmasterAsgd OracleTemplate.Rennala
open outputs.Algorithms.RingmasterTuning

theorem stepSize_pos (L σ ε : ℝ) (R : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ)
    (hε : 0 < ε) (hR : 1 ≤ R) : 0 < stepSize L σ ε R := by sorry

theorem iteration_horizon_sufficient (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params) :
    8 * p.R * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤
      (iterationHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ p.R : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem time_horizon_sufficient (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hL : 0 < p.L) (hε : 0 < p.ε) (hΔ : 0 ≤ p.Δ) :
    8 * threshold p.σ p.ε * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤
      (timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ : ℝ) := by sorry

theorem arrival_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params) (K : ℕ)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.valid p)
    (hK : 8 * p.R * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε + 16 * p.σ ^ 2 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 ≤ (K : ℝ))
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := { outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p with K := K }
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmasterPoint q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmasterPoint q) (fun _ => K) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmasterPoint q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem iterations_success (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.valid p)
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterIterations.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmasterPoint q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmasterPoint q) (fun _ => iterationHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ p.R) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmasterPoint q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem universal_accuracy (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hp : 0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
      ∀ i, RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i))
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O) :
    RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
      (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ < ⊤ →
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmaster q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmaster q) (fun _ => timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmaster q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem universal_success (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params)
    (hp : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.valid p)
    (I : Instance p.d) (O : Oracle (Query (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p))
      (Reply (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p)))
    (hO : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.admissible p I O) :
    let q := outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.publicInput p
    outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.successful p I
      (fun z : (ringmaster q).Seed × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed k) =>
        execute O (ringmaster q) (fun _ => timeHorizon p.L p.σ p.ε p.Δ) z.1 z.2)
      ⟨((ringmaster q).law : Measure _).prod (O.law : Measure _), inferInstance⟩ := by sorry

theorem finite_domain_iff (p : outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.Params) (Q : Prop) :
    (outputs.Setups.RingmasterUniversalTime.spec.valid p → Q) ↔
      ((0 < p.L ∧ 0 ≤ p.σ ∧ 0 < p.ε ∧ 0 ≤ p.Δ ∧
      ∀ i, RennalaUniform.PowerAssumption (p.power i)) →
        RennalaUniform.deadline (fun i t => RennalaUniform.work (p.power i) t / 4)
      (max 1 ⌈p.σ ^ 2 / p.ε⌉₊) ⌈48 * p.L * p.Δ / p.ε⌉₊ < ⊤ → Q) := by sorry

end outputs.Proofs.RingmasterConvergence
